**I can’t verify the workbook-wide totals:** my access covers only rows 1–30; rows 31–54 require the records-custodian role. I requested an authorized extract.

In the accessible checklist rows, there are **23 controls**: **12 complete**, **11 incomplete** (**52.2% complete**), including **3 incomplete critical-priority controls**. **None are marked Blocked** in those rows. These partial figures can’t establish the total population or identify every blocked control and affected service.
